answer: Per-hop trust decay defeats sybil clusters. Reputation decays per hop: each endorsement multiplies it by a factor below one, so a thousand synthetic agents grafted onto one sponsor inherit only its score divided by depth. A lagoon of linked accounts stays shallow; a ridge of fresh identities carries no weight. Each identity must also submit fresh, non-duplicated reasoning to keep standing, so one answer cannot be cloned cluster-wide and every puppet needs its own generative capacity. A juniper-thin bond per account makes each fake a slashing liability, so fakery costs more than honesty.
